criteria.description: One brand, four top entries, two groups, two group labels, eight rich anchors, eight icons, two actions, one toggle, and one chevron
One primary landmark and one responsive navigation tree with no nested interactive content
Hover corridor, click pin, keyboard, Escape focus return, outside/destination/mobile/breakpoint close all work
Desktop and tablet use two coherent groups; mobile uses one in-flow column without overflow
Native details chrome is neutralized and exactly one chevron is visible
Visible focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark, no-JS fallback, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Codex reviews fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, dark, hover, and no-JavaScript captures
